prompt:
This part of a Tekla Structures video shows the End plate (144) dialog, Bolts tab. The tab has a picture of the end plate with the bolt group
and input boxes around it. In Tekla's help the boxes are: horizontal: "number of bolts" (count across), "bolt spacing" (gauge list),
"edge distance" (bolt centre to the plate's side edge), "horizontal bolt group position" with its reference list (Left/Middle/Right);
vertical: "number of bolts" (rows), "bolt spacing" (pitch list), "vertical bolt group position" (from the top) with its reference list
(Top/Middle/Below), "distance from the bottom of the beam to the lowest bolt", and "bolts to delete".
Read at full resolution. For the LAST state of the tab in this part, give each box: where it sits on the picture (e.g. "left of the plate,
top"), which of the help's meanings it is, and its value exactly as shown. Also the bolt size, standard, tolerance, hole type, site/workshop,
bolting direction, and any measurements the presenter makes in the model (with what they measure).
Also give, for each change the presenter makes: time, box, old -> new.
JSON: {"final": [{"position": "...", "meaning": "...", "value": "...", "sure": true}], "other": [{"label": "...", "value": "..."}],
"changes": [{"t": "mm:ss", "box": "...", "from": "...", "to": "..."}], "measurements": [{"t": "mm:ss", "what": "...", "value": "..."}]}

final.position: top left, top edge distance / vertical offset
final.meaning: vertical distance from top edge of plate to first bolt
reference position for top vertical bolt group placement

final.position: bottom left, bottom edge distance / offset
final.meaning: vertical distance from bottom edge of plate to last bolt
number of bolt rows in vertical direction
pitch / spacing between vertical bolt rows

measurements.what: distance between adjacent vertical bolt centers
vertical edge distance from plate top to first bolt center
